findings.title: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages
findings.businessImpact: Meta descriptions were not detected on some assessed pages, which may reduce control over search-result messaging for those pages; unassessed pages remain unknown.
findings.recommendation: Write a unique 150–160 character description for each important page
findings.verificationMethod: Re-crawl the URLs and confirm descriptions are present.

findings.title: Heading structure is inconsistent
findings.businessImpact: Inconsistent heading structure may reduce semantic clarity and accessibility.
findings.recommendation: Use one descriptive H1 per page with sequential H2 and H3 sections
findings.verificationMethod: Re-crawl and verify heading structure on all pages.

findings.title: Security headers are incomplete
findings.businessImpact: Missing browser protections may weaken technical trust.
findings.recommendation: Configure the missing response headers at the hosting layer
findings.verificationMethod: Re-crawl and confirm security headers are present in response.

findings.title: Buyer-question content was not detected in the available partial assessment
findings.businessImpact: The available partial assessment did not detect buyer-question content on the assessed pages, so some buyer questions may remain unsupported there; unassessed pages remain unknown.
findings.recommendation: Add an FAQ based on the questions prospects ask before booking
findings.verificationMethod: Re-crawl and confirm FAQ content is present with structured data where applicable.
